# MOZ_APP_BASENAME: Typically stays consistent for multiple branded
# versions of a given application (e.g. Daily and Thunderbird both use
# "Thunderbird"), but may vary for full rebrandings. Used
# for application.ini's "Name" field, which controls profile location in
# the absence of a "Profile" field, and various system
# integration hooks (Unix remoting, Windows MessageWindow name, etc.)
imply_option("MOZ_APP_BASENAME", "Thunderbird", when=~thunderbird_enterprise)

# MOZ_APP_PROFILE: When set, used for application.ini's
# "Profile" field, which controls profile location.
imply_option("MOZ_APP_PROFILE", "Thunderbird", when=(target_is_windows | target_is_osx) & ~thunderbird_enterprise)
imply_option("MOZ_APP_PROFILE", "thunderbird", when=~target_is_windows & ~target_is_osx & ~thunderbird_enterprise)

imply_option("MOZ_APP_PROFILE", "ThunderbirdEnterprise", when=(target_is_windows | target_is_osx) & thunderbird_enterprise)
imply_option("MOZ_APP_PROFILE", "thunderbirdenterprise", when=~target_is_windows & ~target_is_osx & thunderbird_enterprise)

imply_option("--with-app-basename", "ThunderbirdEnterprise", when=thunderbird_enterprise)
imply_option("--with-app-name", "thunderbird", when=thunderbird_enterprise)
